title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ApiProductOrder
description: An ApiProductOrder is a specialization of a ProductOrder, which can be used to place an order between a customer and a service provider or between a service provider and a partner and vice versa. (TM Forum TMF931 Open Gateway Operate API Onboarding and Ordering 5.2.1, OpenAPI component ApiProductOrder; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ApiProductOrder'

Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF931_OpenGatewayOnboardingAndOrderingComponentSuite/blob/v5.2.1/TMF931-Open_Gateway_Operate_API_Onboarding_and_Ordering-v5.2.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ApiProductOrder/properties/agreement'. In TMF this is an array of AgreementRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Agreement entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Agreement:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

In TMF this is a PartyRoleRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced PartyRole entity (urn:ngsi-ld:PartyRole:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

allOf.description: An identification of an entity that is owned by or originates in a software system different from the current system, for example a ProductOrder handed off from a commerce platform into an order handling system. The structure identifies the system itself, the nature of the entity within the system (e.g. class name) and the unique ID of the entity within the system. It is anticipated that multiple external IDs can be held for a single entity, e.g. if the entity passed through multiple systems on the way to the current system. In this case the consumer is expected to sequence the IDs in the array in reverse order of provenance, i.e. most recent system first in the list.

owner.description: Name of the external system that owns the entity.

externalIdentifierType.description: Type of the identification, typically would be the type of the entity within the external system

id.description: identification of the entity within the external system.

GCProductOrderItem.description: General Context ProductOrderItem that can be used as a Domain Specialization Order Item or as a non-specialised OrderItem.
